  • [Hatcher, homotopies and covers] Allen Hatcher, Algebraic Topology, author-hosted Chapter 2, Theorem 2.10 (printed pp. 111–113), Proposition 2.21 (pp. 119–124), and the open-cover Mayer–Vietoris construction (pp. 149–150). See Appendices A and C for the corresponding homotopy and covering arguments.

  • [Hatcher, singular products] Allen Hatcher, Algebraic Topology, author-hosted additional Chapter 3, the singular cross-product construction, printed pp. 277–279. Appendix D.2 includes the product chain maps, signs and inverse homotopies used here.

  • [Hatcher, Thom and Gysin] Allen Hatcher, Algebraic Topology, author-hosted additional Chapter 4, §4.D, printed pp. 441–444. Appendix D proves the required integral finite-cover version and derives the actual maps of the sequence.

  • [Artin, plane curves] Michael Artin, Notes for a Course in Algebraic Geometry, MIT author course draft, 26 January 2022, §§1.6–1.7, Theorem 8.2.11, and §9.2. Consulted for resultants, projection and the topology problem. Appendix E includes its own convergence, connectedness and ramification arguments.

  • [Hatcher, cellular homology] Allen Hatcher, Algebraic Topology, author-hosted Chapter 2, Lemma 2.34 and Theorem 2.35, printed pp. 137–140. The finite surface comparison used here is proved directly in E.4.

  • [Lebl, coefficient estimates] Jiří Lebl, Guide to Cultivating Complex Analysis, free author edition, version 1.9, 11 July 2026, Theorem 3.3.8 and the growth discussion on printed pp. 79–80. E.1 proves the coefficient estimate and polynomial-growth consequence used in the connectedness argument.

  • [McMullen, adjunction] Curtis T. McMullen, Riemann Surfaces, Harvard author course notes, 28 April 2026, Theorem 14.10, printed p. 123. The tangent, normal and determinant maps at the plane-curve scope are constructed in E.5.

  • [Mathew, Verdier] A. Mathew, Verdier duality, free author notes, 29 July 2011, §§2.3–2.6 and 3–5. Appendices F and H supply the compact-extension, finite-dimension, operation and right-adjoint proofs used here, with explicit total-complex signs.

  • [Schnürer–Soergel] O. M. Schnürer and W. Soergel, Proper base change for separated locally proper maps, arXiv:1404.7630v2, 5 November 2014, §§3–7, especially Lemmas 7.3–7.4 and Proposition 7.5 for the adjoint. Appendices F and H prove the field-coefficient structural and general proper-support constructions used here.

  • [Goresky, notes] M. Goresky, Lecture notes on sheaves and perverse sheaves, free author-hosted notes, version of 10 October 2021, §§9.1–9.4 and 12.4–12.8. Appendix G proves the finite-neighborhood and actual local-model arguments used here; the general Whitney finiteness assertion is not imported as a completed prerequisite.

  • [Mather, stability] J. Mather, Notes on Topological Stability, Harvard University, July 1970, free university-hosted notes, §§1–2 and 6–10, with the first isotopy lemma in §11.1. Appendix I reconstructs the relative tubes, compatible controls, flows and normal product at the finite Whitney scope used here, including their elementary smooth prerequisites.

  • [Haine–Porta–Teyssier] P. J. Haine, M. Porta and J.-B. Teyssier, The homotopy-invariance of constructible sheaves, Homology, Homotopy and Applications 25(2), 2023, 97–128, free author-hosted copy, Theorem 0.4 and Section 5. The bounded field-coefficient interval argument used here is proved directly in J.1.

  • [Stacks algebra] The Stacks Project, freely accessible proofs of Noether normalization, Tag 00OY, Hilbert Nullstellensatz, Tag 00FV, generic freeness, Tag 051R, and going down, Section 10.38. The particular algebraic arguments needed here are proved in K.1–K.4.

  • [Kaloshin] V. Kaloshin, A geometric proof of the existence of Whitney stratifications, free arXiv manuscript, math/0010144v1, 13 October 2000. Comparison for the generic regularity and stratification statements; the complex-algebraic proof used here is in K.1–K.7.

  • [Stacks nodes and completion] The Stacks Project, Artin–Rees, Tag 00IN, completion, Section 10.96, discrete valuation rings, Tag 00PD, nodal curves, Section 53.19, and finite integral closure in a separable extension, Tag 032L. Freely accessible comparison sources for the locally proved arguments in Appendix L.

  • [Stacks, finite monodromy and coefficients] The Stacks Project, effective descent, Tag 023T, Galois categories, Tag 0BN4, finite étale monodromy, Tag 0BND, and the coefficient definitions Tag 03UM and Tag 03UR. Freely accessible comparison texts; Appendix N gives the affine equalizer, pointed-cover and compatible-lattice proofs used here.

  • [Finite-group reduction] J. S. Milne, Group Theory, version 4.01, Lemma 5.1 and Theorem 5.2, pp. 77–78: orbit counting and Sylow existence. Proposition 3.2 supplies the subset count, invariant-vector induction and trace retraction used here.

  • [Coefficient modules] The Stacks Project, Torsion free modules, Section 15.22, Lemmas 15.22.7 and 15.22.11(3). Appendix N.4 gives the coordinate splitting and compact-quotient proofs for the discrete valuation ring coefficients.

  • [Representability] The Stacks Project, Brown representability and Grothendieck abelian categories, Tag 0F5X. BF.1–BF.6 and Proposition 3.3 give the presheaf and sheaf construction, with exact localization, triangles, coproducts and the linked programme proofs of compact representability and unbounded resolutions.

  • [Generic curve completion] The Stacks Project, Curves, Lemma 33.43.7 and Improving morphisms of relative dimension one, Lemma 37.56.1. Appendix O constructs the smooth affine case by normalization over a perfect field, finite diagram descent and the constant-field factorization proved in Appendix AF.

  • [Stacks, abelian sheaf foundations] The Stacks Project Authors, freely accessible proofs of sheafification and exactness, injective embeddings, a cofinality bound, resolution comparison and compatible injective resolutions.

  • [Stacks, relative Cartier algebra] The Stacks Project, Tag 00MF and Tag 062Y. Free comparisons for fibrewise nonzerodivisors and relative effective Cartier divisors; Appendix U supplies the fixed-curve proofs and descent used here.

  • [Stacks, smooth divisor parameters] The Stacks Project, Tag 00T7, Tag 00TA and Tag 0B9H. Free comparisons for standard smooth algebra and the smoothness of divisor schemes; Appendix V proves the coefficient charts and completed-ring identifications used here.

  • [Stacks, coherent cohomology prerequisites] The Stacks Project, Tag 01XB, Tag 01XT and Tag 01YS. Free proof comparisons for affine vanishing, projective twists and coherent finiteness. Appendix W proves the chain used by Q and U over the stated parameter rings.

  • [Stacks, curve divisor foundations] The Stacks Project, Tag 00PD, Section 53.2, Tag 02OH and Tag 0AYZ. Free comparisons for discrete valuations, rational maps and finite pullback of degree. Appendix X proves the divisor and weighted-length calculations and the projective finite-map argument used here.

  • [Stacks, finite-module completion] The Stacks Project, Tag 00IN, Tag 00IQ and Tag 00MA. Free comparisons for Artin–Rees, separation and exact completion of finite modules over Noetherian rings. Section L.1 gives the local proofs and their hypotheses.

  • [Stacks, local growth and regularity] The Stacks Project, Section 10.59, Section 10.60, Tag 00NO and Tag 00NU. Free comparisons for local growth, dimension, associated graded rings and lifting regularity. Appendix Y proves the exact height, polynomial regularity and smooth-parameter consequences used here.

  • [Stacks, splitting algebras and cocycles] The Stacks Project, Tag 074H, Tag 0752 and Tag 03R7. Free comparisons for scalar extension, separable splitting and the cohomological Brauer group. Appendix Z proves the finite algebra, norm and scalar-coboundary calculations used in R.2–R.3.

  • [Stacks, profinite groups and cohomology] The Stacks Project, Section 59.57 and Section 9.22. Free comparisons for continuous group cohomology and infinite Galois theory. Appendix AA gives the continuous-cochain, finite Sylow and restriction calculations used in R.3–R.4.

  • [Stacks, field sites and divisors] The Stacks Project, Tag 02GL, Tag 03QR and Section 59.68. Free comparisons for étale field objects, their Galois sets and the divisor sequence. Appendix AB supplies the local algebra, finite-cover descent, slice calculation and uniformizer lifts used in R.3–R.5.

  • [Stacks, images and open maps] The Stacks Project, Tag 054K, Tag 01UA and Tag 00HR. Free comparisons for constructible images, flat openness and faithful flatness. Appendix AC proves the Noetherian image and prime-lifting statements and the finite-cover basis needed by Appendix S.

  • [Stacks, Picard descent] The Stacks Project, Tag 03P7, Tag 03C4 and Tag 023T. Free comparisons for the Picard identification and faithfully flat descent. Appendix AD gives the rank, effective-family, degree-one and rigidification arguments used here.

  • [Stacks, Picard geometry prerequisites] The Stacks Project, Tag 00TA and Tag 01W7. Free comparisons for smooth local coordinates and projective properness. Appendix AE proves the flatness, graded closed-image and geometric-integrality steps used in P and Q.

  • [Stacks, curve constants] The Stacks Project, Tag 01XL and Tag 01XM. Free comparisons for the affine-cover cohomology and base-change calculations. Appendix AF gives the finite-over-projective finiteness, localization and connected-fibre proofs used in O.4.

  • [Stacks, normalization and normal curves] The Stacks Project, Tag 032L, Tag 00PD and Tag 00TV. Free comparisons for finite normalization, normal curve local rings and the separable-residue smoothness criterion. Appendix AG connects the trace and local algebra calculations to the completion in O.1.

  • [Stacks, finite diagrams and inseparable extension] The Stacks Project, Tag 01Z6, Tag 01ZO and Tag 0BRA. Free comparisons for eventual affineness, eventual finiteness and purely inseparable change of the underlying space. Appendix AH proves the boundary and localization assertions and connects the finite diagram to the programme limit proofs.

  • [Stacks, constructible compactness] The Stacks Project, Tag 0901. Free comparison for compactness of the constructible topology. AI.3 uses the affine ultrafilter proof in the earlier constructible-sheaf lesson and gives its exact role in obtaining a single refinement for a finite family of sheaf maps.

  • [Stacks, ramification] The Stacks Project, Galois extensions and ramification, Section 15.114, and profinite inertia, Tag 0BUA. Free comparisons for finite and profinite inertia. AJ.1–AJ.3 prove the needed strict smooth-curve case from the trace bound, a uniformizer filtration, prime-to-characteristic root extensions and explicit continuous cohomology.

  • [Stacks, cohomological limits] The Stacks Project, continuity, Tag 09YQ, filtered coefficients, Tag 03Q5, and limits of bases, Tag 03Q6. Freely accessible comparison statements and proofs. AK.1–AK.3 give the finite-object, finite-cover and hypercover-cochain descent proof needed for the Noetherian models used here.

  • [Stacks, finite and smooth comparison] The Stacks Project, finite direct images, Tag 03QN, smooth base change, Tag 0EYQ, generic-cover extension, Tag 0EYJ, and smooth connected-fibre neighbourhoods, Tag 0EY4. Free comparison proofs. AL.1–AL.4 give the finite-algebra, curve-invariance and étale-limit arguments used here; AR.1–AR.5 prove the generic-cover extension required by AL.5, and AS.1–AS.7 give the positive-degree cohomological induction over a fixed field with the exact finite-model and two-induction arguments.

  • [Stacks, components along a section] The Stacks Project, base change of the distinguished component, Tag 055M, generic component spreading, Tag 055N, the open neighbourhood criterion, Tag 055Q, and geometric connectedness near a generic fibre, Tag 055G. Free geometric comparisons for AM.1–AM.4.

  • [Stacks, points and slices] The Stacks Project, separable closed points, Tag 056U, étale slices, Tag 057G, and discrete valuation specializations, Tag 054F. Free comparison proofs for the point and specialization constructions in AM.4–AM.6.

  • [Stacks, formal section comparisons] The Stacks Project, completion along a smooth section, Tag 05D5, punctured power-series full faithfulness, Tag 0EY9, bundle comparison from functions, Tag 0EKP, and restriction of finite étale covers, Tag 0EL8. Free comparison proofs for AN.2–AN.6.

  • [Stacks, algebra extension and relative purity] The Stacks Project, finite extension across depth-two complements, Tag 0EY6, reflexive extension, Tag 0EBJ, power-series purity, Tag 0EYA, and purity in smooth families, Tag 0EYB. Free statements for the coherent-extension and relative-purity problems treated in AO.1–AO.6. The kernel and regular-pair proofs there apply to arbitrary Noetherian bases; the integral-scheme reflexive-hull argument is not needed.

  • [Stacks, finite algebra tests] The Stacks Project, the trace criterion for finite étale algebras, Tag 0BJF, and the flat local fibre criterion, Tag 00U6. Free comparison statements for AO.3; the local-equation and trace arguments are given there.

  • [Stacks, flat change of base] The Stacks Project, flat base change, Tag 02KH, and finite free realization of a residue extension, Tag 07NE. The degree-zero equalizer argument is AO.2; the local monic-tower construction is AO.5.

  • [Stacks, regular local purity] The Stacks Project, regular local purity, Tag 0BMA, lifting purity, Tag 0BLS, and the depth-three case, Tag 0BLM. AP.1–AP.5 give the regular-local proof using the coherent extension kernel, completion and a finite residue-field splitting extension.

  • [Stacks, DVR degrees and roots] The Stacks Project, the degree formula, Tag 09E8, Galois transitivity, Tag 09EA, common ramification indices, Tag 09EB, root extensions, Tag 09EV, and Abhyankar’s lemma, Tag 0BRM. AP.6–AP.7 prove the degree and root-base-change statements needed for the Galois situation here.

  • [Stacks, remaining divisor extension] The Stacks Project, extension over a regular boundary, Tag 0H2W, the divisor case, Tag 0EYE, tame local structure, Tag 0EYG, the normalization model, Tag 0EYH, and the transverse section test, Tag 0EYI. AQ.1–AQ.2 prove the regular-boundary extension and AQ.4–AQ.5 give a graded descent proof of the DVR-family case. The broader tame local model is not required by that descent proof.

  • [Stacks, gluing near a point] The Stacks Project, gluing in a closed fibre, Tag 0BQ5, and spreading the finite étale property, Tag 0EY3. AQ.1 gives the finite multiplication-table and denominator-clearing proof used to add the codimension-one points; AR.2 proves the base-local gluing with its finite-chart hypotheses.

  • [Stacks, actions and finite covers] The Stacks Project, equivariant sheaves and gradings, Tag 03LE, and finite étale morphisms, Tag 0BL6. AQ.3 proves the fibrewise identity test, and AQ.4 writes the coefficient calculation for the action of the roots-of-unity group over a ring.

  • [Stacks, extension over a normal base] The Stacks Project, generic Galois cover extension, Tag 0EYJ. AR.1–AR.5 give the splitting, base-local gluing and completed-section argument, and explicitly remove the temporary quasi-compactness restriction on the smooth family.

  • [Stacks, smooth comparison induction] The Stacks Project, smooth base change, Tag 0EYQ, Lemma 59.89.1, the first proof of Theorem 59.89.2, and Lemma 59.89.3. Freely accessible comparison arguments; Appendix AS proves pointed finite-group effacement, finite replacement of the vanishing problem, the two cohomological inductions and bounded-below comparison over a fixed field, with field-based normalization and explicit continuity arguments.

  • [Stacks, strict-local acyclicity] The Stacks Project, local acyclicity, Tag 0GJM, Definition 59.93.1, Proposition 59.93.2 and Lemma 59.93.3. Freely accessible comparison statements and proofs. Appendix AT supplies strict-local stalk and base-change identifications, arbitrary allowed constant groups, bounded-below locally constant cohomology, and the selected-neighbourhood colimit used in the affine-line argument.

  • [Stacks, proper coherent geometry] The Stacks Project, Chow modification, Tag 0200, proper coherent images, Tag 02O3, formal functions, Tag 02O7, and Noetherian Stein factorization, Tag 03H0. Freely accessible statements and proofs. AU.1–AU.6 give the projective-coordinate, support-induction, completion and connectedness arguments, followed by the proper finite-fibre consequence.

  • [Stacks, approximation and connectedness] The Stacks Project, absolute approximation, Tag 07RN, general Chow modification, Tag 0202, fibre idempotents, Tag 0G7X, and general Stein factorization, Tag 03H2. Freely accessible proofs. AV.1–AV.6 give the finite-data deductions, nonaffine ambient construction, projective coordinates, proper thickenings and connectedness argument.

  • [Stacks, quasi-finite factorization] The Stacks Project, Tag 03GD, Tag 03GE, Tag 00UH, Tag 00UI, Tag 00UJ, Tag 02LN, Tag 03GW, Tag 05K0. Freely accessible proofs. AW.1–AW.6 prove the integral-closure comparison, finite-piece construction, nonaffine finite factorization and finite refinement of étale coverings, using the specified earlier programme algebra and limit proofs.

  • [Stacks, henselian sections] The Stacks Project, Tag 09XI, Tag 09Z8, Tag 09ZG, Tag 095S. Freely accessible comparison proofs for henselian pairs and degree-zero proper restriction. AX.1–AX.7 give the ring, spectral-space, finite-map and sheaf arguments at the stated arbitrary-base scope.

  • [Stacks, proper sections] The Stacks Project, Tag 03N0, Tag 09XM, Tag 09XN, Tag 0A3H, Tag 00I7, Tag 0A3I, Tag 03Q9, Tag 095S. Freely accessible comparison statements. AY.1–AY.6 prove descent of opens and sheaf sections, geometric field invariance, section continuity and the canonical proper degree-zero base-change formula.

  • [Stacks, constructible embeddings] The Stacks Project, Tag 03RY, Tag 09Z5, Tag 09Z4, Tag 09YU. Freely accessible comparison statements. AZ.1–AZ.6 prove finite presentations, compactness, affine-limit descent, the normal-generic section calculation and finite-direct-image embeddings of constructible coefficients.

  • [Stacks, finite effacement] The Stacks Project, Tag 04D1, Tag 0EZN, Tag 03Q6, Tag 03AJ. Freely accessible comparison statements. BA.1–BA.7 prove affine étale lifting, closed-subscheme constant-coefficient vanishing, arbitrary-base higher continuity and finite-cover and torsion-sheaf effacement.

  • [Stacks, henselian cohomology] The Stacks Project, Tag 0EM7, Tag 09Z8, Tag 0A51. Freely accessible comparison statements. BB.1–BB.4 prove the henselian-neighbourhood construction, affine torsion comparison, module-injective acyclicity and the affine-covering bound; BB.5 identifies the proper torsor-lifting input proved in BD.6.

  • [Stacks, proper cover algebraization] The Stacks Project, Tag 0885, Tag 088C, Tag 0BQC. Freely accessible comparison statements. BC.1–BC.6 prove coherent algebraization and finite-cover and torsor lifting over complete Noetherian pairs, and the complete-local projective-line comparison. BD.3–BD.6 supply pointed approximation and extend the finite-cover and projective-line results to arbitrary henselian local bases.

  • [Stacks, finite cover descent and pointed approximation] The Stacks Project, Tag 01ZM, Tag 07QY. Freely accessible limit and approximation statements. BD.1–BD.2 prove finite-cover descent. BD.3–BD.6 use the earlier programme regular-completion and smooth-factorization proofs to establish pointed approximation, henselian proper finite-cover lifting and projective-line comparison.

  • Derived-complete inverse image, Tag 099K, and constant Noetherian coefficients, Tag 099N. Free comparisons for the completed adjunction and operation maps in BL; the explicit proofs are given there.

  • Proper–open exchange, Tag 0F7A, and derived lower shriek via compactifications, Tag 0F7H. Free comparisons for the exchange, refinement, composition and base-change constructions used in BM; its completed coefficient and inverse-limit proofs are written there.

  • Uniform constructible coefficient bounds, Tag 09C2. Free comparison for BN.1; its Tor filtration and descent to the étale coefficient category are proved explicitly there.

  • Finite-coefficient local structure, Tag 09BI, stabilization, Tag 09C5, and adic local structure, Tag 09C6. Free comparisons for BO; its finite Tor induction, compatible matrices, finite-image stabilization and internal-Hom lifting give the complete local-model proof at the stated coefficient scope.

  • Strict coefficient-system normalization, Tag 03UN, and finite-level kernels, Tag 03UP. Free comparisons for BP; its common stratification, uniform torsion bound, quotient recovery and full degree-zero equivalence are proved there.
